records.pipeline_name: High Island Offshore Gas Pipeline System

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Rigzone article from July 2025 says Delfin has a long-term lease on the High Island Offshore System pipeline from West Cameron block 167 south to the Delfin Deepwater Port site.

verifications.note: Says Delfin has a long-term lease for the HIOS pipeline from WC 167 south to the Delfin Deepwater Port location.

records.researcher_notes: The sheet already says yes with Delfin. A July 2025 Rigzone article names the pipeline and the Delfin terminal, so the existing values stay and the ref is added.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The line starts at the Sabine Pass LNG site in Cameron Parish. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from December 2018 says the Sabine Pass Expansion Project added a lateral and tap for Sabine Pass Liquefaction, the export plant. An article from 2008 says it was first approved to carry regasified gas from the import terminal.

verifications.note: Says Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline placed the Sabine Pass Liquefaction lateral and tap in service as part of the Sabine Pass Expansion Project.
2008 FERC approval of the line to carry regasified LNG from the Sabine Pass import terminal.

records.researcher_notes: The line ties to Sabine Pass in two ways. It was built to move gas from the import terminal, and a 2018 expansion added a lateral to the liquefaction plant so it also feeds export. The tie to export is through the expansion, so confidence is medium.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Steelhead LNG release from September 2015 announced a pre-construction agreement with Williams for the Island Gas Connector to supply the proposed Malahat LNG facility on Vancouver Island.

verifications.note: Reprint of the Steelhead LNG release naming the Island Gas Connector and the Malahat facility.

records.researcher_notes: The pipeline was meant to feed a terminal in Canada, and the project is cancelled. The flag is left blank because the terminal is in Canada and no source says the gas is US gas exported as LNG. On 17 November 2026 the flag column changed from yes or blank to export or import, and this line is marked export.

ledger.note: Sheet already had yes and Delfin. A Rigzone article from July 2025 confirms Delfin leases this pipeline for its deepwater port.
Line starts at Sabine Pass. A 2018 trade article ties a lateral on it to the Sabine Pass liquefaction plant.
Feeds the proposed Malahat terminal in Canada. Flag left blank because no source ties it to US gas exports.
Searched for an LNG tie. Sources say the project served the C4GT power plant in Charles City County. No LNG tie found.
EIA text says the laterals supply the Oracle data center campus at Abilene. No LNG tie.
Energy Transfer sources call it a Permian takeaway line to Texas hubs. One report mentions Gulf Coast LNG but no official source or named terminal ties this project to LNG, so left blank.

EIA says the expansion serves Kimmeridge and other shippers and delivers Eagle Ford gas to Gulf Coast and Mexico markets. Kimmeridge's Commonwealth LNG interest is company-wide, not stated for this project.
A compression project on this system mentions takeaway pipelines serving LNG, but no source ties the whole pipeline to an LNG terminal.
